Iteration 1 Highlights & Wave-2 Candidate Root Causes (#77) #

  • Wave 1 Wins: Terran PkArmy +174%, Trade +118% (wins vs monsterbot 5.40x & Chance 4.32x, 60 MULEs in #13); Zerg out-macros opponents (W@4m=26.4, 5.45 bases); PvZ Gateway #1 dropped 116s -> 47-50s; saving_for=spore-crawler cleared; avg step time 9.31ms -> 7.94ms.
  • Top 5 Wave-2 Root Causes Identified (#77):
